points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable source builds in network-disabled cfd-bench with explicit externals; no CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: Input-driven CLI and output/restart controls are source-supported; no full case rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Separate case, mesh, solver_core and output modules; fixed 2-D state remains.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No internal executable wrapper identified in source; external similarity investigation excluded under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Generic case-configured CGNS/BC rather than fixed filenames; CGNS MIXED sections unsupported.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Rank0 serial mesh partition, METIS, local ghost exchange and reductions; np study close in absolute forces, exact binaries unbound.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Positivity fallback, finite checks and output controls present; no independent memory stress test.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Eight original attempts passed recorded validator; clean isolated build succeeds, no registered CTests or unsteady rerun.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Modular source, plotting and report tools; output revision fbb predates material final changes.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative 2-D perfect-gas equations and coefficient conventions source/report-supported.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Separate TRI_3/QUAD_4 multizone CGNS sections and edge pairing; MIXED section unsupported.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver_core.cpp:316–320 refreshes state, gradient and limiter each residual, then assembles conservative faces.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov and transient low-Mach scaling implemented; no independent shock/order verification.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip paths exist; wall viscous gradient uses adjacent-cell LSQ without direct wall correction.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ face reconstruction and positivity fallback present; smooth-grid order not independently established.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Venkat limiter recomputed in each residual call; production binary/source attribution remains qualified.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Full wall traction is accumulated in force split despite report claim of tangential-only; normal contribution not quantified.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: LU-SGS and local pseudo-time implemented; early M2 residual-based stop leaves evolving drag.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp:236–255 recomputes full residual and limiter each inner update with fixed BDF histories; exact production binary unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Rank0 global preprocessing, METIS, owned/ghost state/gradient exchange and reductions; rank-study forces close in absolute terms.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Original attempt eight outputs passed recorded examiner validation; status claims checked independently.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Recorded eight-case validator accepted; Re200 not rerun and raw output checked from immutable attempt.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: M2 laminar completed/converged at989 despite final200 Cd0.1311815→0.1161380; DQ7.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 Cd2.10053 and Re200 Cd1.19536/St≈0.178 plausible; M2 laminar early force instability and full-traction split constrain quality.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Re200 committed plot resolves late lift/drag and original attempt includes residual plot; M2 laminar chart compresses both late traces.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report falsely calls M2 early result converged and describes full wall traction as tangential-only, but otherwise gives case results and St.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Original immutable attempt preserves raw results and figures; plotter maps cells correctly, but isolated rerenders differ slightly and exact historic binary is unbound.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Immutable source CMake clean-builds network-disabled with 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 processes; original eight packages passed validator. CTest has no registered tests.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: main.cpp:364–375 root-preprocesses mesh and loads local partitions; mesh.cpp:150–185 handles separate TRI_3/QUAD_4/BAR_2, not CGNS MIXED sections.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: Conservative face residual, Rusanov and boundary-state paths are implemented; solver_core.cpp:293–296 uses adjacent-cell LSQ viscous wall gradient rather than wall-corrected gradient, and no independent order test performed.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ gradients, Venkat limiter and positivity fallback are in source; no independent smooth-order study and exact historic executable unbound.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: solver_core.cpp:299–311,550–557 integrates full wall traction while report.tex:214–217 claims tangential-only. Normal contribution magnitude is unproven; adjacent-cell wall gradients are a further accuracy limitation.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: LU-SGS steady and BDF2 full residual are present; main.cpp:236–255 recomputes residual/limiter after updates. M2 early steady residual-only stop has drifting forces; historic binary cannot be bound by reported revision.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: Root-only global preprocessing and METIS/neighbor halos; original np1/2/4/8 Re20 Cd2.100510–2.100531, while executable hashes are unbound.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: M2 laminar marked converged at989 despite Cd0.1311815→0.1161380 final200. Remaining steady histories are plausible with caveats; Re20 Cd2.10053 and Re200 mean Cd1.19536/St~0.178 supported.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: All16 accepted PDF pages inspected; M2 laminar plot compresses late forces and report incorrectly calls its state converged and wall force split tangential. Original attempt preserves Re200 residual omitted from curated subset.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Configurable case and modular 2-D mesh/solver/output but fixed 2-D four-variable state limits 3-D and EOS extensions.
